name: Sissy Diaries
source:
Welcome to "Sissy Diaries," the naughty and tantalizing adult visual novel that will take you on a journey of self-discovery and passion. Meet our protagonist, a married man who indulges in his passion for crossdressing in secret.

[From [url=https://inkandtease.itch.io/sissy-diary]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到《Sissy Diaries》，一部调皮撩人的成人视觉小说，带你踏上自我发现与激情的旅程。来认识我们的主角吧：一位悄悄享受女装爱好的已婚男人。

[摘自[url=https://inkandtease.itch.io/sissy-diary]itch.io[/url]]
